Advanced Data Protection Schema Resource Get Schema Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dlpExactDataMatchSchemas/lite

Gets a list of active EDM templates (or EDM schemas) and their criteria (or token details), only.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
schemaName
string

The EDM schema name.

activeOnly
boolean

If set to true, only active EDM templates (or schemas) are returned in the response.

Default value: true
fetchTokens
boolean

If set to true, the criteria (i.e., token details) for the active templates are returned in the response.

Default value: true
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
schema
object
tokens
object[]
]
